chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah from Safwan from Ibn Muskan from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said:
The reversion (raj'ah) is with sexual intercourse, and otherwise, it is only one (divorce).

key_terms.الرَّجْعَةُ: Raj'ah: The right of a husband to take back his wife during the 'iddah (waiting period) after a revocable divorce.
key_terms.وَاحِدَةٌ: Wahidah: One (referring to a single revocable divorce, as opposed to a final or second divorce).

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a valid raj'ah (reversion) in Islamic divorce law?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from Imam al-Rida (AS), the condition for 'raj'ah' (reconciliation) during the 'iddah of a revocable divorce is clarified as requiring actual sexual intercourse, distinguishing it from mere cohabitation. This ruling underscores the juristic consensus that physical consummation is the definitive act restoring the marital bond, preventing the divorce from advancing to a 'talaqah khulfa' (second divorce).
